tweets.text:
ILLEGAL ALIEN WANTED FOR AGGRAVATED SEXUAL ASSAULT OF A CHILD – ARRESTED
7/10 – Brownsville, TX: A Mexican national illegally present in the U.S. and wanted for aggravated sexual assault of a child was taken into custody following a swift joint operation. After Harlingen PD issued an arrest warrant on July 2, federal partners acted without delay. USBP, ICE, and the U.S. Marshals located and apprehended the suspect. He is now in custody, pending criminal proceedings, with an immigration detainer in place.

We remain relentless in our mission to protect communities and bring dangerous criminals to justice.

tweets.text:
$84k WORTH OF METH SEIZED!

7/14- A USBP K9 led agents to 106 lbs. of meth hidden in a trash bag and two suitcases during a vehicle stop in San Clemente, CA. DEA took custody of the drugs and the individual who now faces charges for possession with the intent to distribute (21US841).
 
Since October, USBP and partners have seized over 22,000 pounds of meth, with a mind-blowing street value of $67.6 million. That's a massive amount of poison kept off our streets.

ILLEGAL ALIEN CONVICTED OF SEXUAL ASSAULT OF A CHILD -ARRESTED! 

7/12- USBP agents in Brownsville, TX, apprehended David Varcenas-Aguilar, a convicted sex offender attempting to illegally enter the United States. During processing, biometric checks confirmed Aguilar has a prior conviction for sexual assault of a child and was sentenced to 12 years confinement for the crime he committed in Houston, TX. The Mexican national, who was previously deported, now faces felony charges for illegal re-entry (8USC1326).
